{{- /* The theme stylesheet: main.css.tmpl filled with the brand.json tokens, then Tailwind. Development links it as is; a production build minifies it and adds an integrity hash. The first header row's own stylesheet (header-css.html) loads after it. */ -}} {{- $brand := hugo.Data.brand -}} {{- $css := resources.Get "css/main.css.tmpl" | resources.ExecuteAsTemplate "css/main.css" $brand -}} {{- $opts := dict "inlineImports" true -}} {{- if hugo.IsDevelopment -}} {{- with $css | css.TailwindCSS $opts -}} {{- end -}} {{- else -}} {{- with $css | css.TailwindCSS (merge $opts (dict "optimize" true)) | fingerprint -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{ partial "header-css.html" . }}
